pediatricPearls: Use pediatric dosing of medications or electrical therapy for a pediatric patient < 37 kg and as defined by the HandTevy.
Pediatric hypotension is defined as SBP < 70 + (age in years x 2) mmHg

pl1: Compress bridge or base of the nose
pl2: Adult: Consider Isotonic Crystalloid bolus titrated to MAP > 65 mmHg for adults
Pediatric: Consider Isotonic Crystalloid bolus titrated to SBP > 70 + (age in years x 2) mmHg
